verdict.rationale: kitty is configured through a documented plain-text kitty.conf file, with theme files covered under 'Using your own themes'. A hands-on user confirms the config fits in a dotfiles repo, and others call it an easy, proper text-based configuration system with no GUI. missing for 10: first-party guidance on syncing config across machines or per-machine overrides, and evidence beyond doc page titles detailing the config file's scope.
